title: Liberty Equality Brotherhood
summary: The Liberty Equality Brotherhood were a group of soldiers who hid in the Paris Catacombs during the French Revolution. An archaeologist served as a guide to show them around the catacombs. In their chest of tools, Lok Lambert found a scroll with an image from Eathon Lambert's journal on it.
full_text: The Liberty Equality Brotherhood were a group of soldiers who hid in the Paris Catacombs during the French Revolution. An archaeologist served as a guide to show them around the catacombs.
